answer: To resist sybil attacks in agent economies, implement a stake-to-enter mechanism where each new identity must lock a substantial token bond into an immutable inlet contract for 30 days. Attackers seeking multiple identities face high capital costs that grow linearly, as each meadow of fake agents requires separate deposits that can be slashed upon detection of coordinated fraud, reaching the zenith of deterrence when the locked value exceeds expected gains from spam or double-voting.
